segments.text:
V. 7.
I will have mercy and not ſacrifice—That is, when they interfere with each other, I always prefer Acts of Mercy, before Matter• of poſitive Inſtitution: Yea, before all ceremonial Inſtitutions whatever; becauſe theſe being only Means of Religion, are ſuſpended of courſe, if Circumſtances occur, wherein they claſh with Love, which is the End of it.
